model.name: deepseek-v4-flash
model.note: reasoning disabled after an uncapped trace burned ~33k completion tokens per call

stores.postgres: PostgreSQL 17 + pgvector 0.8.2 (HNSW, vector_cosine_ops) + pg_trgm + GIN tsvector

stages: LLM writes SQL from the full schema
text_to_sql.repair: one retry on exception or zero rows

vector_rag.repair: none — no query language to repair

stages: LLM writes stage-1 Cypher to identify entities
system deterministically expands each entity (not LLM-authored)
exact text fetch by accession_number primary key
LLM answers from graph facts + snippets
graphrag.repair: one retry on exception or zero rows

guardrails.why: a generated LIMIT on a fan-out join lets one entity consume the budget and the model then reports the others do not exist

pass_requires: at least one required keyword present
at least one correct citation where ground-truth citations exist
scoring.halluc_def: not correct and not refused and (a forbidden entity named or a citation outside the valid set)
scoring.uncited_def: required entities and keywords present, nothing false, but no correct citation

fairness: same model, temperature, reasoning setting and max_tokens for all arms
equal LLM call budget: 2 for SQL and GraphRAG, 1 for vector RAG
complete schema shown to text-to-SQL so multi-hop answers are reachable by joins
the surname-first name convention documented in BOTH schema docs
one repair attempt for both query-writing arms
identical LIMIT/fan-out guardrail on both query languages
two of four question types chosen so the graph is the wrong tool

providers: AWS Bedrock (EC2 instance profile, no static credentials)

cross_model_probe_T3_2_graphrag.bedrock/claude-haiku-4-5: fail — Cypher returned TARGET CORP alone, missing Apple and Bank of America

harness_bugs_found: the SQL schema doc omitted the surname-first convention the graph doc included — an asymmetry that made text-to-SQL fail for the wrong reason
a use-before-assignment scored text-to-SQL 0/12 for an entire run
the citation scorer penalised legitimate citations on aggregate questions with no ground-truth citation set
a 900-token answer cap truncated answers mid-citation, converting passes into uncited
pgvector post-filtering returned 0 of 8 rows while 164 matched until hnsw.iterative_scan was enabled — vector RAG had been scored on an empty retriever
concurrent torch encode() segfaulted the interpreter; a shared psycopg connection interleaved cursors across threads
a global token counter attributed every thread's tokens to whichever mode read it first

T4-5 ground truth accepted one of three filers that genuinely list AllianceBernstein Holding L.P.; all three arms were naming a real parent and being marked wrong. Corrected and all 180 answers re-scored offline: text-to-SQL 28->29, vector RAG 6->9, GraphRAG 44->45

disjointness.note: the three facts a multi-hop question needs live in three document types

sql_pathology.cause: joins subsidiary x filing_section x reporting_owner without narrowing first

observed.note: values read from the stored model answers; cited in the failure analysis
